messages:
Ivy (AE): Jordan from HeliosCorp wants a POC next week. Their must-haves: SSO (SAML) + SCIM for a one-time import of ~50k users and then daily deltas, RBAC group sync, and domain ownership verification. Two tricky items: contractors route through a rewrite proxy that changes NameID format, and they want SCIM 'replace' semantics during a 10m sync window (~400 rps). Also pricing: they
re leaning away from Hosted if cost is high for sustained syncs. @Rach @Clara any quick reads?

Rach (SE): Short answer: we can handle multi-format NameIDs with our alias mapping (keyed by issuer+subject). If the proxy preserves issuer we can canonicalize; if not we create alias entries and optionally flag for admin review. For SCIM: recommend staged bulk-import + PATCH deltas with page size 500 rather than full PUT replace for 50k. Example ingest pattern: curl -X POST https://redwood/api/v1/bulk-import -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -F file=@users.csv

Naveen (Eng): Implementation notes: enable name_id_aliases=true, scim_chunk_size=500, scim_throttle=tenant_token_bucket. We
lso add alias_write_cooldown=30s during initial import to avoid DB thrash. For RBAC sync we map SCIM groups -> internal roles and persist audit events.

Clara (Security): Security flags: SCIM bearer token rotation (hourly) must be validated; audit retention >1yr requested? Hosted supports AES-256 + cloud KMS, but BYO-HSM or separated logs implies Private. If they need guaranteed physical separation or HSM-backed keys, escalate to Private.

Jordan (Prospect): Confirming contractor proxy keeps same Azure issuer but rewrites NameID to username-style string. We'll upload metadata and a sample CSV. For pricing: if Dedicated reduces cost for sustained 400 rps, what's a ballpark monthly commit for a 3-month POC?

Ivy (AE): Rach  can you drop a ballpark so we can prepare the quote? Also scheduling a 30m tech sync Tue 10am PT with Jordan, Rach, and Clara.

Rach (SE): Ballpark: Dedicated reserved pool (S-class) with burst  mid-five-figure USD/month for that sustained sync + audit retention. Short-term POC commits often available; will confirm exact numbers with pricing-ops and post link.

Naveen (Eng): We'll open ticket POC-90022 to enable temporary higher SCIM rate for the POC and preconfigure aliasing flags.

Clara (Security): I'll prefill security questionnaire items (token rotation, KMS options, audit trails, RBAC audit events) and flag HSM/private notes.

Jordan (Prospect): Good plan  will upload CSV + metadata by EOD and join Tue. Thanks everyone!
